'''T6''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] owned by [[Aryn Leneer]]. It had an orange, domed head and communicated in the beeps and whistles of [[Binary/Legends|droidspeak]]. He assisted in piloting her [[PT-7 starfighter]].
